subject: POC plan & prompt/eval dataset collection - ACME Health
content:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@acmehealth.com>, Mike Jordan <mike.jordan@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC plan & prompt/eval dataset collection - ACME Health

Hi Alyssa / Mike —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps for the POC so we can get you a runnable eval quickly: 

Summary of needs we heard:
- You want a 2-week trial to validate quality on your clinical triage prompts and internal knowledge-base responses.
- Primary success criteria: >= 92% acceptable responses on representative prompt set, <5% hallucination incidents, latency <500ms p50 for short prompts, and cost target under $0.30 per 1k tokens for typical traffic.
- You'll provide a sample prompt set and a small redacted user log for evaluation.

Proposed POC plan (high level):
1) Dataset collection (owner: ACME): ACME shares CSV of ~500 representative prompts + 200 redacted real user prompts or logs. We recommend CSV columns: prompt_id, prompt_text, expected_answer (optional), context_tags.
2) Redwood validation & eval harness (owner: Redwood - Vivek): We run the prompts through a couple of model variants, compute metrics (acceptability, hallucination rate, latency, cost per token), and produce a short report with sample failure cases.
3) Acceptance criteria & timeline (mutual): Start: target week of Mar 29. Data due by Mar 22. Run & analysis: 1 week. Presentation of results and next steps: by Apr 9.
4) Security & data handling: Redwood will process redacted prompts in our sandbox Dedicated environment; we can sign an NDA and provide our SOC2 summary if needed.

Attachments: I attached our POC template (redwood_poc_template.xlsx) to make data collection easier.

Immediate asks for ACME:
- Please share the sample prompt CSV and any redaction notes by Mon, Mar 22.
- Confirm the technical contact for logs and S3 access (if you'll share via S3).

I'll loop Vivek and Dev on the technical details below. Thanks!

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0147

---

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Jordan <mike.jordan@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 18:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: POC plan & prompt/eval dataset collection - ACME Health

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Attaching our initial sample prompts CSV (acme_sample_prompts.csv). It's a first pass; you'll see we redacted PHI columns and replaced with [PATIENT_AGE], [CONDITION]. We can provide a separate small redacted log excerpt (200 rows) if that helps — I'll confirm by tomorrow.

Technical contact for logs/S3 access is Mike Jordan (cc'd). We'll plan to have the dataset to you by EOD Mon, Mar 22.

Also, can you confirm whether Redwood needs the expected_answer column for each prompt or if you can evaluate against a human review panel?

Thanks,
Alyssa
Sr Product Manager, Clinical Ops
ACME Health
alyssa.chen@acmehealth.com

Attachment: acme_sample_prompts.csv (CSV, 512 KB)

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@acmehealth.com>, Mike Jordan <mike.jordan@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 20:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC plan & prompt/eval dataset collection - ACME Health

Perfect, thanks Alyssa — got the sample prompts and noted the redaction approach. Answer to your question: either works for us. If you provide expected_answer we can run automated acceptability scoring and compare to human labels; if not, we can run the prompts through model variants and produce a human-evaluation set (we'll sample ~100 prompts) and return annotated judgments. Providing expected_answer speeds up the process.

I've attached a filled POC template with the fields we need (redwood_poc_template.xlsx). A few clarifications from our side: 
- For logs: redacted JSON lines or CSV are fine; we only need the user prompt and a minimal context string.
- For privacy we prefer datasets with PHI removed — if that's not possible, we can run in your Dedicated account with customer-managed keys.
- For the acceptance metric: we'll propose a blended score (70% acceptability, 30% hallucination penalty) but happy to align if you have a different rubric.

Next steps I propose:
- ACME to upload sample dataset + S3 details or Drive link by Mon, Mar 22.
- Vivek will scope the env and confirm whether we need a temporary Dedicated instance for redacted logs.
- Internal kickoff: Wed, Mar 24 (30 mins) to align on evaluation rubric and runbook.

Thanks — looping Vivek and Dev for technical scheduling.

Best,
Marissa

Attachment: redwood_poc_template.xlsx

---

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@acmehealth.com>, Mike Jordan <mike.jordan@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC plan & prompt/eval dataset collection - ACME Health

Thanks — quick technical notes from my side: 
- If the sample prompts are already redacted, we can run them in our hosted sandbox. No Dedicated instance required unless ACME wants customer-managed KMS.
- For evaluation, please include a column indicating "prompt_type" (triage_question, kb_lookup, follow_up) if possible; it helps segment results by workload.
- Recommended minimal metadata: prompt_id, prompt_text, prompt_type, expected_answer (optional), timestamp_bucket.
- We'll aim for the two model variants: rwd-3b-quant (fast/cost-efficient) and rwd-7b (higher accuracy). We'll report p50/p95 latency, tokens per response, acceptability score, and hallucination incidents with examples.
- For logs via S3, please grant redwood-poc@redwood-svc role read-only to the bucket; or share a Drive link.

I'll start prepping the eval harness and can post a runnable test job once we have the CSV. Proposed internal kickoff Wed 24th 10:30am PT — Marissa / Lauren if that works for you both please confirm so we can invite ACME.

-Vivek
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com

Best,
Alyssa
